info.name: Just Eat UK Attempted Delivery API Checkout API

params.name: tenant
params.description:
A two-character country code. 

The following countries are supported:
  - United Kingdom (UK)
  - Australia (AU)
  - New Zealand (NZ)

params.name: checkoutId
params.description: A unique identifier for a checkout. This is currently a Basket Id.

items.docs:
Get the details required to fulfil an order, which includes:
  - The restaurant selling the items to be purchased
  - The customer making the purchase
  - How, where and when the items will be received by the customer
  - Instructions about the order
